Billy , might wonder where the sweetness lay. Annual seaside holidays in Rothesay provides one of his Proustian memories in this concluding half of his memoir, along with knitted woolly swimming trunks and 'the poetry of swearing'.

## ===

## Big Fat Quiz Of Everything 9pm,Channel4

Following Christmas Eve's Big Fat Quiz Of The Year , celebrity question-setters Jon Snow and Charles Dance (among others) tickle the much wider general knowledge of Sandi Toksvig - her QI training coming in handy here - Joe Lycett, Katherine Ryan, David Baddiel, Frank Skinner and Big Narstie. Jimmy Carr asks questions that range from Polish film titles to Digger the Crab.

## The Wolf Of Wall Street 9pm,More4

(Martin Scorsese, 2013)

Scorsese's 21st feature film is adapted fromanunrepentant tell-all memoir by Jordan Belfort (played by Leonardo DiCaprio, left ), a cocksure but legally shady and morally repugnant founder of an upstart brokerage firm, who, before he was eventually brought low by an FBI investigation in the late 90s, amassed more wealth than Croesus would have known what to do with. It is an exhilarating, exhausting three-hour audiovisual bacchanalia of obscene conspicuous consumption, prostitutes and strippers, yachts and helicopters, drugs, sex and more drugs. And it is late-period Scorsese's flashiest, funniest work by some margin.
